item.title: Topcoat Makes Rust 'Full-Stack'? I Ran a 36-Line Version and Found the Argument Is All in the Wording
item.description: tokio-rs shipped Topcoat 0.10.0 to crates.io; the HN thread is 9 days old and still hot — the top comment calls it a DSL, 'a wrong pattern'. I built a 36-line minimal version on a 2-core EPYC: clean build 3m57s zero warnings, incremental 13.6s, real first frame returned. Once you run it, the dispute is mostly wording: $(...) is type-checked Rust, and the no-JS fallback goes Post/Redirect/Get.
